articles.title: Women's World Cup returning to U.S. shows how the game has grown since 1999
articles.summary: Women's soccer was forever changed when the U.S. hosted the 1999 World Cup. With it returning in 2031, ESPN charts the game's explosive growth.

articles.title: U.S. to co-host Women's World Cup in 2031; U.K. wins bid for 2035
articles.summary: The United States has been confirmed as co-hosts of the 2031 Women's World Cup, before the United Kingdom hosts the tournament four years later.

articles.title: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland & Wales to host 2035 Women's World Cup
articles.summary: The United Kingdom will host a football World Cup for the first time since 1966.

articles.title: Raya to miss Dortmund game but injury 'not serious'
articles.summary: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya will miss Tuesday's Champions League game against Borussia Dortmund but his shoulder injury will not require an operation.

articles.title: Andreatta's masterplan to shock Sweden & take Scots to World Cup
articles.summary: Scotland intend to bring fancied Sweden's World Cup dream "crashing down - and do it in a truly Scottish way", says manager Melissa Andreatta.

articles.title: UK confirmed as  2035 Women's World Cup hosts - which stadiums will be used?
articles.summary: The UK has been confirmed as the host of the 2035 Women's World Cup.

articles.title: Raya injury 'not too serious' says relieved Arteta
articles.summary: Mikel Arteta has revealed that David Raya's shoulder injury is not as bad as first feared, but is unsure when the Arsenal goalkeeper will return to action.
